## The heuristic

**Speed of first response and speed of resolution pull against each other, and which one you are buying must be a decision.**


_Why:_ Interrupting deep work to acknowledge new arrivals raises responsiveness and lowers throughput. Both are defensible; what is not defensible is having chosen neither and being surprised at whichever one is failing.
